newsitem.title: USA: US Air Force depot contract awarded to 8 companies.
newsitem.headline: US Air Force depot contract awarded to 8 companies.

text.p: The U.S. Air Force on Tuesday said it awarded eight companies a $165 million contract to take over depot work at McClellan Air Force Base in California and Kelly Air Force Base in Texas.

The contract was part of a program to save the jobs of some depot workers at the bases. President Clinton approved a plan to end the Air Force's operation of the depots only if private companies took over the work.
The eight companies are Lucent Technologies, Dyncorp, Call Henry Inc., OAO Corp., Karta Technologies, CACI Automated Systems Group, TAD Resources, and Trend Services, the Air Force said.
